jobs_results.description:
Principal Quantitative Analyst - Model Risk Office





At Capital One data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.


As a Quantitative Analyst at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in cloud computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.


As a Quantitative Analyst within the Model Risk Office, you will be part of the validation team responsible for balance sheet forecasting and economic stress test models used to determine capital requirements for Capital One's balance sheet items, including commercial and consumer loans.  Validations cover all aspects of model development and performance and include forward-looking advancements in modeling capabilities and quality. With a network of over 500 quantitative analysts, data scientists and statisticians, we’ve created a dynamic environment with ample opportunities for learning and growth. 


Responsibilities and Skills:

- Partner with the various lines of business to develop and enhance Capital Markets modeling and analytical framework, such as deposit predictions, derivatives models and fixed income models.

- Work across Capital One entities to create novel analytical solutions to challenging business problems.

- Identify opportunities to apply quantitative methods and automation solutions to improve business performance and process efficiencies.

- Collaborate in a cross-disciplinary team to build cloud-based solutions grounded in data.

- Identify opportunities to apply quantitative methods or machine learning to improve business performance.

- Apply deep expertise in mathematics, statistical and machine learning methods to generate critical insights and decision frameworks for our business and customers.

- Providing technical guidance to business leadership.

- Communicate technical subject matter clearly and concisely to individuals from various backgrounds.

- Understand and navigate Risk Management Software to enable business analysis.
  

Expertise in quantitative analysis is central to our success in all markets. Our modelers thrive in a culture of mutual respect, excellence and innovation. 


Successful candidates would possess: 

- Deep understanding of quantitative modeling in finance include but not limited to, financial time series model, interest rate term structure, Mortgage Prepayment Model,  Market Risk Model, capital markets and investment portfolio modeling principles.

- Extensive experience in Python or other object-oriented languages such as C++.

- Ability to clearly communicate modeling results to a wide range of audiences.

- Drive to develop and maintain high quality and transparent model documentation. 

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Strong presentation skills. 

- Ability to fully own the model validation process: from conceptualization through data exploration, model selection, benchmarking, deployment, replication, independent testing, effective challenging, and performance monitoring. Able to communicate and socialize with various audience stakeholders about potential findings such as model user, model owner, and model developers

jobs_results.description:
At U.S. Bank, we're on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at-all from Day One.



Job DescriptionU.S. Bank is seeking the position of Quantitative Model Analyst in Cupertino, California.



Essential Responsibilities:

The Quantitative Model Analyst is responsible for the validation and independent review of financial and risk models used in business decision-making, including credit risk and other related quantitative and statistical models supporting banking products and services. The position evaluates model conceptual soundness, performance, implementation, and ongoing monitoring to ensure alignment with business and risk management requirements. It reviews model assumptions, methodologies, and results, and assesses data integrity and overall model effectiveness. The position conducts periodic validation and revalidation across multiple financial model types and portfolios using quantitative and statistical tools, and identifies model limitations, performance issues, and risk exposures. It documents findings, conclusions, and recommendations, and communicates validation results and risk assessments to model owners, business stakeholders, and management, including escalation of issues and tracking of remediation actions. The role prepares formal validation reports and supporting documentation in accordance with internal governance and regulatory requirements, and participates in model governance activities while contributing to enhancements of validation processes, documentation standards, and related controls. Position may allow working from home within a commuting distance from worksite location. Multiple Positions.



Basic Qualifications:

Requires a Master's degree in Statistics or Mathematics plus 1 year of experience as a Quantitative Model Analyst or related.



Required Skills/Experience:
Must possess 1 year of experience with all of the following: development, implementation, and analysis of financial and risk models within a regulated financial environment at a commercial bank; development and maintenance of credit risk models, including probability of default (PD), loss given default (LGD), and exposure at default (EAD); statistical and financial analysis using regression analysis, time series analysis, scenario analysis, and model performance testing in support of credit risk and capital planning activities; support of regulatory and internal financial reporting processes, including CCAR and CECL stress testing; analysis of portfolio performance and economic data across commercial and consumer lending products; preparation of model governance, validation support, and regulatory documentation; evaluation of model assumptions, methodologies, and results; identification of model risks and limitations; support of model monitoring and remediation activities with model owners and model risk management; documentation of model development and governance activities in formal reports; use of programming and analytical tools, including Python, SQL, and SAS; and use of reporting tools Tableau and Power BI in large-scale data environments. Position may allow working from home within a commuting distance from worksite location.



Base pay range may vary if an offer is made for work in a different location. Pay Range: $97,677.00 - $173,000.00 (#LI-NDI #LI-DNI #LI-DNP #DE-DNP #IND-DNP)

jobs_results.description:
Job Description: 
  Job Purpose


 The Quantitative Analyst will join the Quant Group which designs, implements, and supports enterprise quantitative models and systems. The primary role for this position will be to provide model research, development, and strategic recommendations to solve practical problems in the financial industry. The candidate for this job must have the ability to work in a fast-paced environment, formulate and articulate solutions and defend assumptions. This role requires frequent interaction with Quant Research, Data Analytics, Risk Management, Technology Development and Senior Management.


 


 

    Responsibilities


 
  Design and develop quantitative model analytics frameworks to assess model usage and performance.
  Create relevant test data sets, and portfolio strategies to be submitted to the model validators and regulators.
  Investigate model behavior, carry out root cause analysis, and give model improvement suggestions.
  Provide documentation of methods, techniques, results, and analysis.
  Analyze large data sets, including positions, prices, and other market/liquidity data.
  Research and design innovative quantitative solutions for stakeholders.
  Develop and support in-house quantitative R&D platform and analytics tools to automate model testing, analysis, and visualization.
 
 


 

    Knowledge and Experience


 
  Master’s Degree or above in math, quantitative finance, physics, statistics, computer science or similar quantitative fields.
  Proficiency in Python, SQL, and object-oriented programming.
  Advanced knowledge in math (stochastic process, probability theory, numerical methods).
  Ability to work in a high-performance, high-velocity environment.
  Strong analytical and organizational skills with acute attention to detail.
  Strong communication skills in both verbal and written English.
 
 


 

    Preferred


 
  Strong knowledge of Python, SQL, and C++.
  Strong knowledge in object-oriented programming.
  Work experience in Options Pricing Theory.
  Work experience in Data Analytics.
  -: Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics.

jobs_results.description:
Senior Quantitative Analyst - Global Finance





At Capital One data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.


As a Quantitative Analyst at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in cloud computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.


This position offers a unique opportunity to be a part of the modeling and quantitative analytics team in the dynamic Capital Markets & Analytics (CMA) organization at Capital One. The CMA organization has been on a technology journey seeking to find ways to leverage technology to drive deeper market insights, manage financial risks and make the complex simple.  We are looking for candidates to help in our journey with modeling, analytical and model implementation skills.


Responsibilities and Skills:

- Partner with the various lines of business to develop and enhance Capital Markets modeling and analytical framework, such as  derivatives models and fixed income models.

- Work across Capital One entities to create novel analytical solutions to challenging business problems.

- Identify opportunities to apply quantitative methods and automation solutions to improve business performance and process efficiencies.

- Collaborate in a cross-disciplinary team to build cloud-based solutions grounded in data.

- Identify opportunities to apply quantitative methods or machine learning to improve business performance.

- Apply deep expertise in mathematics, statistical and machine learning methods to generate critical insights and decision frameworks for our business and customers.

- Providing technical guidance to business leadership.

- Communicate technical subject matter clearly and concisely to individuals from various backgrounds.

- Understand and navigate Risk Management Software to enable business analysis.
 

Expertise in quantitative analysis is central to our success in all markets. Our modelers thrive in a culture of mutual respect, excellence and innovation. 


Successful candidates would possess: 

- Deep understanding of quantitative modeling in relation to finance, capital markets, derivatives and investment portfolio modeling principles.

- Extensive experience in Python or other object-oriented language.

- Ability to clearly communicate modeling results to a wide range of audiences.

- Drive to develop and maintain high quality and transparent model documentation. 

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Strong presentation skills. 

- Ability to fully own the model development process: from conceptualization through data exploration, model selection, validation, deployment, business user training, and monitoring.
 

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an exception that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Master’s degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 1 year of experience in quantitative analyticsAt least 1 year of experience in each of the following skills through education or experience:Statistical or econometric modelingLinear and logistic regressionProgramming in R, Python or SQLPresenting statistical concepts and research results to non-statistical audienceAt least 1 year of experience in at least 3 of the following skills:Survival analysis modelingTime-series analysisPanel data (longitudinal data or cross-sectional time-series data) analysisCross-sectional data analysisMachine learningAnalysis and management of large datasets (>1M records)
Preferred Qualifications:

2 years of experience with Python, R or other statistical analyst software
Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.

jobs_results.description: About us   At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living while reducing emissions. As one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.   The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower-emissions technologies.    We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs. Learn more about our What and our Why and how we can work together.What role you will play in our team   If successful, you will be an integral part of our Global Trading Analytics organization, supporting LNG trading, portfolio optimization, and structured commercial activities across global gas markets. We are seeking a highly motivated quantitative analyst with strong valuation, structuring, and modeling capabilities to develop and enhance analytical frameworks, pricing models, optimization tools, and decision-support solutions that enable commercial decision-making across LNG and related gas value chains.   In this role, you will serve as a front-office quantitative partner to LNG traders, originators, and structurers, providing transparent, independent, and commercially actionable valuation expertise. You will evaluate and price embedded optionality within LNG supply and offtake agreements, shipping portfolios, regasification capacity, gas sourcing strategies, and complex structured transactions while supporting real-time commercial decisions. Success in this position requires the ability to translate sophisticated quantitative analysis into actionable insights that drive trading, optimization, hedging, and portfolio management decisions in a dynamic and evolving market environment.  What you will do    Develop, implement, and maintain quantitative valuation and optimization models supporting LNG trading, portfolio management, structured transactions, and commercial decision-making. Partner directly with LNG traders, originators, and structuring teams to provide real-time valuation, optionality analysis, and quantitative support for commercial opportunities. Evaluate and price embedded optionality across LNG supply and offtake agreements, destination flexibility, cargo diversion rights, volume tolerances, storage agreements, shipping portfolios, and regasification capacity. Support traders and originators in structuring commercial transactions, including development of pricing methodologies, exposure analysis, valuation approaches, sensitivities, and commercial recommendations. Build analytical frameworks to assess LNG portfolio optimization opportunities across global gas markets, including sourcing, transportation, storage, shipping, and market placement decisions. Develop and enhance pricing, valuation, and optimization models utilizing stochastic methods, scenario analysis, Monte Carlo simulation, and optimization techniques. Analyze market relationships across LNG, natural gas, shipping, storage, and related commodity markets to identify drivers of value, portfolio optimization opportunities, and commercial risks. Support valuation and risk assessment of long-term LNG contracts, spot transactions, shipping agreements, tolling arrangements, regasification agreements, and other structured commercial opportunities. Advise traders and originators on hedging strategies and risk mitigation approaches by identifying hedgeable and residual exposures across LNG and related gas markets. Provide independent valuation and quantitative challenge to proposed transactions, ensuring robust commercial decision-making and transparent risk assessment. Conduct back-testing, model validation, parameter calibration, and assumption analysis to improve model accuracy, robustness, and commercial relevance. Collaborate closely with quantitative analysts, technology teams, and data engineers to develop scalable and production-ready analytical solutions. Create and maintain valuation tools, optimization frameworks, dashboards, and model infrastructure that improve transparency, efficiency, and front-office decision support. Participate in commercial discussions with traders, originators, and senior stakeholders, clearly communicating valuation methodologies, optionality drivers, sensitivities, and portfolio impacts. Contribute to the development of quantitative best practices, valuation methodologies, and model governance standards across the organization.   What you bring    Master's or PhD degree in Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Financial Engineering, Operations Research, Economics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline. Demonstrated front-office quantitative experience supporting commodity traders, originators, or structuring teams within LNG, natural gas, power, commodity trading, or energy trading organizations. Experience working directly with traders and commercial decision-makers to evaluate transactions, develop pricing approaches, assess risk exposures, and identify value creation opportunities. Strong quantitative and analytical problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex modeling outputs into commercially actionable recommendations. Experience developing valuation, optimization, or quantitative models supporting LNG, natural gas, power, shipping, commodity trading, or related energy markets. Strong understanding of option pricing theory, stochastic modeling, optimization techniques, simulation methodologies, and risk analytics. Experience evaluating and pricing commercial optionality including volume flexibility, destination flexibility, storage optionality, transportation optionality, shipping optionality, and structured commodity transactions. Proficiency in Python and experience with quantitative analytics libraries, optimization frameworks, and data science toolsets. Experience working with large and complex datasets to generate actionable business insights and commercial recommendations. Knowledge of market risk concepts, valuation methodologies, portfolio analytics, and trading performance measurement. Experience with model validation, back-testing, calibration, and analytical governance frameworks. Understanding of global LNG markets, natural gas pricing hubs, shipping economics, transportation constraints, and portfolio optimization principles. Proven ability to communicate effectively with traders and commercial stakeholders in a fast-paced front-office environment. Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively while managing multiple priorities and delivering high-quality analytical support under tight commercial timelines.    Preferred Qualifications    Advanced degree in a quantitative field. Significant experience partnering directly with traders and originators on transaction evaluation, deal structuring, portfolio optimization, and commercial strategy development. Experience supporting LNG trading desks, LNG portfolio management teams, gas trading organizations, commodity trading houses, investment banks, or energy merchants. Experience valuing LNG supply agreements, LNG offtake contracts, shipping portfolios, regasification capacity, storage assets, transportation agreements, and structured LNG transactions. Knowledge of global LNG markets, including Atlantic and Pacific Basin trade flows, LNG pricing mechanisms, shipping dynamics, destination flexibility, and portfolio optimization strategies. Experience with derivative pricing, Monte Carlo simulation, stochastic processes, optimization techniques, and advanced quantitative methods. Familiarity with LNG contract structures, diversion economics, volume management provisions, and commercial optimization opportunities. Experience with cloud-based analytics platforms, distributed computing environments, and modern data architectures. Familiarity with software engineering best practices including version control, testing, documentation, and model deployment. Experience supporting front-office trading and origination organizations where rapid commercial decision-making and direct trader engagement are critical to success.
